glosses: cane (plant with simple stems, like bamboo or sugar cane)
reed (any of various types of tall stiff perennial grass-like plants growing together in groups near water)
slim, cylindrical type of glass, used to serve beer

examples.text: En Cuba se cultiva mucha caña de azúcar.
examples.en: A lot of sugar cane is grown in Cuba.

examples.text: Tom lanzó su caña y esperó a que piquen los peces.
examples.en: Tom threw his line in and waited for the fish to bite.
